question: Who is the chief minister of Delhi as of October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atishi Marlena**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Atishi Marlena** is the Chief Minister of Delhi as of October 2024, succeeding Arvind Kejriwal.
 
• Atishi is a senior leader of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and has been a prominent figure in Delhi's education reforms.
 
• She has been instrumental in implementing key initiatives like the transformation of Delhi's government schools and the introduction of the "Happiness Curriculum."
 
• Atishi holds a degree from St. Stephen's College, Delhi, and further pursued her education at the University of Oxford as a Rhodes Scholar.
 
• Her leadership focuses on governance reforms, public welfare, and ensuring inclusive development for all citizens in Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP):**

 
 
• AAP was founded in 2012 by Arvind Kejriwal and others following the anti-corruption movement led by Anna Hazare.
 
• The party's core agenda focuses on transparency, anti-corruption, and public welfare.
 
• AAP has been in power in Delhi since 2015, focusing on education, healthcare, and infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **Happiness Curriculum:**
 
 
• Introduced in Delhi government schools in 2018 to promote emotional well-being and mindfulness among students.
 
• It includes meditation, storytelling, and activities aimed at fostering self-awareness and critical thinking skills.
 
 
 
• **Education Reforms in Delhi:**
 
 
• Under the AAP government, massive investments have been made in improving the quality of education in government schools.
 
• Initiatives like "Mission Buniyaad" focus on bridging learning gaps among students.
 
• Delhi government schools have been recognized nationally and internationally for their infrastructure and academic results.
 
 
 
• **Delhi Governance Model:**
 
 
• The Delhi governance model emphasizes accessible healthcare through "Mohalla Clinics" and improved public services.
 
• Water and electricity subsidies have been key welfare measures under AAP's leadership.
